title: rough-patch config.yaml
description: Settings in .rough-patch/config.yaml at the git root. Every setting except schema is optional.

schema.description: The format version: the rough-patch release that introduced it.

url.description: The target. Skips Nuxt detection; trusted once it passes the loopback check.

start.description: The command --start runs in the git root: a string, or a list run side by side.

startTimeout.description: Seconds --start waits for the app to answer.

ready.description: A JavaScript expression that replaces the ready wait after every full page load.

reset.description: Runs once per flow-running invocation, before the sign-in flow, in the git root.

exclude.description: Page path patterns no flow may visit.

remoteTarget.description: The one non-loopback host the target may use.

remoteWrites.description: Exact hosts the browser may write to. No wildcards.
